name: 15206 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15206 (Pittsburgh) has 187 nonprofit organizations. 103 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 82 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15206 (Pittsburgh) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15206 (Pittsburgh) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
